🆕 Newly listed (posted: September 30, 2026)

An online lecture on gender equality will be held featuring author Genro Shiraiwa discussing fatherhood and modern challenges for men.

Author Genro Shiraiwa will share his experience as a father and episodes from his published works, reflecting on thoughts from child-rearing and issues surrounding modern men. This lecture offers an opportunity to think about the role of fathers in the home and society.

【Date and time】 December 6, 2026 (Reiwa 8, Sunday) 10:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m. (noon)

【Format】 Zoom online lecture

【How to watch】
Online viewing from home (capacity 280 people, first-come first-served)
Screening venues in the region (first-come first-served)
  • Hanno City Library (19-5 Yamate-cho, capacity 50, opens 10:00 a.m.)
  • Shinjishoze Community Development Center (1-8-3 Midori-cho, Tokorozawa, capacity 50)
  • Shin-Sayama Community Center (2-17-1 Shin-Sayama, Sayama, capacity 30)
  • Iruma City Health and Welfare Center (730-1 Kami-Fujisawa, Iruma, capacity 50)
  • Hidaka City Lifelong Learning Center (370-20 Shikayama, Hidaka, capacity 40)

【Speaker】 Genro Shiraiwa (author)

【Who can attend】 Residents, employees, or students of Tokorozawa, Hanno, Sayama, Iruma, or Hidaka

【Participation fee】 Free

【Registration period】 October 19, 2026 (Reiwa 8, Monday) 9:00 a.m.–November 30 (Monday) 4:30 p.m.

【How to apply】 Online application or phone: Human Rights, Lifestyle & Safety Division 042-973-2111 (extension 6202), Monday–Friday 9:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. (excluding holidays)

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jinkenkurashianzen/kurashi/10236.html
